en.text: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.

zhSimplified.text: 亚当的后代记在下面。（当 神造人的日子，是照着自己的样式造的，

zhTraditional.text: 亞當的後代記在下面。（當上帝造人的日子，是照着自己的樣式造的，

en.text: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.

footnotes.text: 5:2 “Adam” and “Man” are spelled with the exact same consonants in Hebrew, so this can be correctly translated either way.

zhSimplified.text: 并且造男造女。在他们被造的日子， 神赐福给他们，称他们为「人」。）

zhTraditional.text: 並且造男造女。在他們被造的日子，上帝賜福給他們，稱他們為「人」。）

en.text: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.

zhSimplified.text: 亚当活到一百三十岁，生了一个儿子，形象样式和自己相似，就给他起名叫塞特。

zhTraditional.text: 亞當活到一百三十歲，生了一個兒子，形像樣式和自己相似，就給他起名叫塞特。

en.text: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.

zhSimplified.text: 亚当生塞特之后，又在世八百年，并且生儿养女。

zhTraditional.text: 亞當生塞特之後，又在世八百年，並且生兒養女。

en.text: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

zhSimplified.text: 亚当共活了九百三十岁就死了。

zhTraditional.text: 亞當共活了九百三十歲就死了。

en.text: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.

zhSimplified.text: 塞特活到一百零五岁，生了以挪士。

zhTraditional.text: 塞特活到一百零五歲，生了以挪士。

en.text: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

zhSimplified.text: 塞特生以挪士之后，又活了八百零七年，并且生儿养女。

zhTraditional.text: 塞特生以挪士之後，又活了八百零七年，並且生兒養女。

en.text: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.

zhSimplified.text: 塞特共活了九百一十二岁就死了。

zhTraditional.text: 塞特共活了九百一十二歲就死了。

en.text: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.

zhSimplified.text: 以挪士活到九十岁，生了该南。

zhTraditional.text: 以挪士活到九十歲，生了該南。

en.text: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

zhSimplified.text: 以挪士生该南之后，又活了八百一十五年，并且生儿养女。

zhTraditional.text: 以挪士生該南之後，又活了八百一十五年，並且生兒養女。

en.text: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.

zhSimplified.text: 以挪士共活了九百零五岁就死了。

zhTraditional.text: 以挪士共活了九百零五歲就死了。

en.text: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.

zhSimplified.text: 该南活到七十岁，生了玛勒列。

zhTraditional.text: 該南活到七十歲，生了瑪勒列。

en.text: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters

zhSimplified.text: 该南生玛勒列之后，又活了八百四十年，并且生儿养女。

zhTraditional.text: 該南生瑪勒列之後，又活了八百四十年，並且生兒養女。

en.text: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.

zhSimplified.text: 该南共活了九百一十岁就死了。

zhTraditional.text: 該南共活了九百一十歲就死了。

en.text: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.

zhSimplified.text: 玛勒列活到六十五岁，生了雅列。

zhTraditional.text: 瑪勒列活到六十五歲，生了雅列。

en.text: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

zhSimplified.text: 玛勒列生雅列之后，又活了八百三十年，并且生儿养女。

zhTraditional.text: 瑪勒列生雅列之後，又活了八百三十年，並且生兒養女。

en.text: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.

zhSimplified.text: 玛勒列共活了八百九十五岁就死了。

zhTraditional.text: 瑪勒列共活了八百九十五歲就死了。

en.text: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.

zhSimplified.text: 雅列活到一百六十二岁，生了以诺。

zhTraditional.text: 雅列活到一百六十二歲，生了以諾。

en.text: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

zhSimplified.text: 雅列生以诺之后，又活了八百年，并且生儿养女。

zhTraditional.text: 雅列生以諾之後，又活了八百年，並且生兒養女。

en.text: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.

zhSimplified.text: 雅列共活了九百六十二岁就死了。

zhTraditional.text: 雅列共活了九百六十二歲就死了。

en.text: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.

zhSimplified.text: 以诺活到六十五岁，生了玛土撒拉。

zhTraditional.text: 以諾活到六十五歲，生了瑪土撒拉。

en.text: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

zhSimplified.text: 以诺生玛土撒拉之后，与 神同行三百年，并且生儿养女。

zhTraditional.text: 以諾生瑪土撒拉之後，與上帝同行三百年，並且生兒養女。

en.text: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

zhSimplified.text: 以诺共活了三百六十五岁。

zhTraditional.text: 以諾共活了三百六十五歲。

en.text: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.

zhSimplified.text: 以诺与 神同行， 神将他取去，他就不在世了。

zhTraditional.text: 以諾與上帝同行，上帝將他取去，他就不在世了。

en.text: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.

zhSimplified.text: 玛土撒拉活到一百八十七岁，生了拉麦。

zhTraditional.text: 瑪土撒拉活到一百八十七歲，生了拉麥。

en.text: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

zhSimplified.text: 玛土撒拉生拉麦之后，又活了七百八十二年，并且生儿养女。

zhTraditional.text: 瑪土撒拉生拉麥之後，又活了七百八十二年，並且生兒養女。

en.text: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.

zhSimplified.text: 玛土撒拉共活了九百六十九岁就死了。

zhTraditional.text: 瑪土撒拉共活了九百六十九歲就死了。

en.text: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.

zhSimplified.text: 拉麦活到一百八十二岁，生了一个儿子，

zhTraditional.text: 拉麥活到一百八十二歲，生了一個兒子，

en.text: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which the LORD has cursed.”

zhSimplified.text: 给他起名叫挪亚，说：「这个儿子必为我们的操作和手中的劳苦安慰我们；这操作劳苦是因为耶和华咒诅地。」

zhTraditional.text: 給他起名叫挪亞，說：「這個兒子必為我們的操作和手中的勞苦安慰我們；這操作勞苦是因為耶和華咒詛地。」

en.text: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

zhSimplified.text: 拉麦生挪亚之后，又活了五百九十五年，并且生儿养女。

zhTraditional.text: 拉麥生挪亞之後，又活了五百九十五年，並且生兒養女。

en.text: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.

zhSimplified.text: 拉麦共活了七百七十七岁就死了。

zhTraditional.text: 拉麥共活了七百七十七歲就死了。

en.text: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

zhSimplified.text: 挪亚五百岁生了闪、含、雅弗。

zhTraditional.text: 挪亞五百歲生了閃、含、雅弗。
